review_policy: Only reviewed, reproducible non-Critical findings are listed. A baseline preserves visibility and never suppresses scanner evidence.

findings.reason: Known middleware configuration; applicability to token-authenticated API endpoints requires deployment review.
Deployment-dependent HSTS policy; proxy and domain rollout requirements are not documented in this repository.
Deployment-dependent HTTPS redirect may be owned by the reverse proxy; deployment contract is absent.
The deploy check intentionally uses a deterministic local-only contract key; production secret strength was not inspected.
Secure session-cookie ownership and production override are not documented; kept visible for deployment review.
Current settings hard-code DEBUG=True and local checks inherit it; production deployment override could not be verified.
Local frontend is intentionally absent; the password-reset redirect lands on the disposable backend and returns an unexpected content type.
Scanner self-version alert; explicitly not a product defect and retained until the pinned image is updated.
Cross-origin isolation headers are deployment-dependent; no production proxy contract is available.
Version header is emitted by Django's disposable development server, not evidence of the production serving stack.
Generated unauthenticated and invalid-resource requests correctly produced client errors; retained as scan coverage metadata.
Authentication request identification is an informational scanner observation, not a product bug.
Session-management response identification is an informational scanner observation, not a product bug.
